title: Affiliate Insurance Relationship and the Home Purchase Financing Deferral Charge
content:
**Affiliate relationship pricing note — Home Purchase Financing deferment fees**

Where the borrower's in-force Hearthstone Insurance Agency policy names Hearthstone Home Finance as loss payee and is billed to the loan escrow, the relationship fraction is 0.5; where such a policy names Hearthstone Home Finance as loss payee but is billed another way, the relationship fraction is 0.75. Where the borrower has no in-force Agency policy naming Hearthstone Home Finance as loss payee, no relationship fraction applies.

The deferral charge charged is the deferral charge, already rounded half up to the cent, times the relationship fraction, rounded half up to the cent again. The facts are read from the borrower's Manufactured Home Insurance policy with Hearthstone Insurance Agency: its status, its loss payee and its billing plan.

| In-force Manufactured Home Insurance policy names Hearthstone Home Finance as loss payee | Billed to the loan escrow | Relationship fraction |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.5 |
| yes | no (billed another way) | 0.75 |
| no such policy | — | none applies |

*Hypothetical example.* A rounded deferral charge of 14.10 becomes 14.10 times 0.5, that is 7.05, on an escrow-billed policy; on a policy naming Hearthstone Home Finance but billed by EFT it becomes 10.575, rounded half up to 10.58.
